summary: Retested public pages/forms, admin authentication, reservation rejection, booking approval, property state transitions, reports, documents/gallery listing, upload validation, and mobile layout.

integration_issues.issue: Associate Portal renders for an authenticated admin instead of redirecting by role; its associate API returns 403, leaving a failed/blank portal with the Emergent unhandled rejection overlay.

action_items: Enforce role matching in PortalLayout or route guards: super_admin sessions must redirect away from associate routes and associate sessions away from admin routes; avoid rendering a portal before role validation.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js PortalLayout checks only whether user exists, not whether user.role matches the requested portal. This causes authenticated cross-portal navigation to render and then fail on a backend 403.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed inquiry leads and reservation/booking records through public workflow tests; no manual seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API/pages, inquiry form, projects data after API wait, admin dashboard, mobile no-overflow, reservation reject/retry, booking approval, reports/listing routes, and invalid upload validation pass. Retest cross-role browser navigation after PortalLayout guard fix.
rca of the issue: PortalLayout uses only `if (!user)` and does not compare the authenticated role with the portal title. An admin visiting /associate/dashboard therefore stays authenticated in the associate shell; the subsequent /api/associate/dashboard call correctly returns 403, but the UI has no error state and the overlay reports an unhandled rejection.
